sources: Sources: Dexerto 24 Nov, GameRant + VICE 25 Nov 2026

slides.label: STATUS: PLAYER-REPORTED
slides.title:
Scarface is hiding
in Ocean Beach.
slides.body: Players found a scene from the 1983 film rebuilt in GTA 6. It only works at midday.

slides.label: EXHIBIT A: THE DOOR
slides.title:
A locked door
at noon.
slides.body: Get to Ocean Beach between 12 and 1 PM in-game. Take the stairs up to the rooms and try the first door. It won't open. That's the trigger.

slides.label: EXHIBIT B: THE STREET
slides.title:
Walk away.
Then go back.
slides.body: Head down to the street. A man in a yellow shirt goes down, straight out of the film. Back upstairs, the door is open.
slides.highlight: GameRant: don't use the stairs you came up.

slides.label: VERDICT: OPEN CASE
slides.title:
Say hello to
my little friend.
slides.body: Inside: the film's infamous bathroom, and the Little Friend W-10 SMG on the floor, ready to grab.
slides.cta: Send this to the friend who quotes Scarface on every drive.
